info.name: Pioneer DJ DJM-S9
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ mapping for the Pioneer DJ DJM-S9: the browser, loops, performance pads, effects and faders. The mixer mixes the sound itself; openDJ follows its faders. Beta: written from the mixer's MIDI messages, not yet tried on the hardware.
